svg.title: BLE 5 - A singer leaves the gathering

g.text: BLE 5 - A singer leaves the gathering
songlist sheet → "Kampvuur verlaten" (or system back) [guiDesign D-34]
confirm: "Je ziet de liedteksten dan niet meer" → Verlaten / Blijven
connect; write Control 0009 = 0x01 ‖ seal_ek{tok, cid, op 10 leave, gid} [9.8]
remove sid (and from dlg), invalidate tok,
leave anyway; the leader's 10-minute rule catches up [10.11]
stop scanning; discard every document received
in this gathering (song, setlist, message, reqstat) [FR-DATA-01, FR-DATA-06]
write the gathering memory: name, date, titles sung
(no names, no device ids) [FR-DATA-03, guiDesign D-49]
forget tok, sid, xk and the pinned pk
Explicit leave since protocol v0.11 (Control op 10): the count drops at once.
A singer that walks away without it is handled by the 10-minute rule below.
[the singer walks out of range (or Bluetooth is switched off)]
header strip "opnieuw verbinden…", lyrics stay as they are [FR-GATH-10, guiDesign D-37]
[beacon or frames with the same gid return within the set time (default 5 min)]
compare seq; the carousel delivers whatever was missed
[the singer sends a request while reconnected]
connect, Join with the known sid → same tok, not counted twice [9.3]
state ENDED: treat the gathering as ended [10.11]
"Het kampvuur is niet meer te vinden" [guiDesign D-37]
discard documents, write the gathering memory,
discard queued requests with a message [FR-DATA-01, FR-REQ-03]
a singer with no GATT activity for 10 min is removed from the count;
the beacon and state show the lower "singers" figure [10.9, FR-GATH-12]
its token stays valid until the gathering ends;
a rejoin with the same sid returns the same token [9.3]
